plain.text: Some Pharisees and religious teachers saw Jesus' disciples eating without the ceremonial hand-washing their tradition required. They asked Jesus why. He quoted Isaiah: "These people honour me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me." He said they set aside God's commands to keep their own traditions. For example, God commands, "Honour your father and mother," but they let people avoid helping their parents by saying the money was "Corban", an offering to God.

Jesus called the crowd and said, "Nothing outside a person can make them unclean by going into them. It is what comes out of a person that makes them unclean." In private, he explained to his disciples: food goes into the stomach, not the heart. (By this, Jesus declared all foods clean.) But from the heart come evil thoughts, stealing, murder, adultery, greed, lies, envy, pride and other evils. These are what make a person unclean.

Jesus went to the region of Tyre, outside Israel. A Greek woman whose little daughter had an evil spirit begged him for help. Jesus said, "First let the children eat. It is not right to take the children's bread and throw it to the dogs." She answered, "Lord, even the dogs under the table eat the children's crumbs." Jesus said, "Because of this answer, you may go. The demon has left your daughter." She went home and found her child lying on the bed, free.

In the region of the Ten Cities, people brought a man who was deaf and could hardly speak. Jesus took him aside, put his fingers in the man's ears, touched his tongue, looked up to heaven, sighed and said, "Ephphatha!" which means "Be opened!" At once the man could hear and speak clearly. People were overwhelmed: "He has done everything well. He even makes the deaf hear and the mute speak."

summary.bigIdea: What matters most to God is the heart, and Jesus' mercy reaches beyond Israel.
points: Jesus challenges traditions that push aside God's commands.
He teaches that evil comes from the heart, not from food.
A non-Jewish mother's faith is honoured, and a deaf man is healed.
summary.reflection: Jesus said the heart is what matters. What is coming out of your heart in your words and actions?
